printers.detail: Industry body (International Association of Currency Affairs) profile of the Banque Centrale de Mauritanie 20-ouguiya polymer note launched 28 November 2021; a third-party announcement, not confirmed on the bank's own site.
printers.source_title: Product Owner: Banque Centrale de Mauritanie - 20 Ouguiya
printers.quote: The new note is printed by Canadian Banknote Company whilst supported by CCL Secure for the Guardian polymer substrate.

printers.detail: Bank of Uganda's director of currency Dr Bazizi told a parliamentary committee that the bank's banknote printing contract is with Oberthur Fiduciaire, signed 26 July 2018; reported by The Independent (Uganda).
printers.source_title: BoU complained to money printer for breach of contract - The Independent Uganda
printers.quote: the contract between BOU and M/s Oberthur Fiduciare was entered into in July 26, 2018

printers.name_as_stated: Imprimerie Oberthur / the French company Oberthur
printers.detail: Wikipedia's article on the convertible mark states all denominations except the KM 200 are printed by Oberthur; not confirmed on the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina's own site.
printers.source_title: Bosnia and Herzegovina convertible mark - Wikipedia
printers.quote: Banknotes, with the exception of the KM 200 note, are printed by the French company Oberthur.

printers.detail: Wikipedia states OeBS was selected after an international tender to print the KM 200 note; not confirmed on the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina's own site.
printers.source_title: Bosnia and Herzegovina convertible mark - Wikipedia
printers.quote: After an international tender, the Austrian company Oesterreichische Banknoten und Sicherheitsdruck GmbH (OeBS) was selected to print the KM 200 note.

printers.detail: Wikipedia's article on the Iraqi dinar says the 2003 series, still the basis of circulating notes, was printed by De La Rue; not confirmed on the Central Bank of Iraq's own site.
printers.quote: with the notes printed by De La Rue again

printers.detail: Wikipedia's article on the Israeli new shekel names Orell Füssli Security Printing of Switzerland as the printer of the banknotes, including the polymer note; the Bank of Israel's own currency pages name no printer.
printers.quote: The banknotes are printed by Orell Füssli Security Printing of Switzerland.

printers.detail: Wikipedia's article on the Georgian lari gives Oberthur Fiduciaire as the printer in its infobox; the same article says the 2016-2019 series was produced in collaboration with Oberthur Technologies, Giesecke+Devrient and De La Rue without saying which firm printed which denomination, so the other two are not filed.
